toolInput.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE completely newly composed, finished premium character-centered semi-realistic fantasy game splash illustration. Portrait exactly 2:3, 1024 x 1536 or higher native equivalent, opaque full scenic background, no typography or card frame.

REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is ONLY the facial identity and adult body-proportion reference. Preserve her recognizable face shape, eyes and their spacing, nose, lips, soft expression, skin tone, slim waist and naturally long, slender adult legs. She is an adult woman in her twenties. Do not enlarge the eyes, shrink her face, exaggerate her chest or change her body proportions. Image 2 is the precise weapon design reference: faithfully incorporate that single long sniper rifle, its thumbhole stock, large scope, straight barrel, folded bipod, white/black chassis and cyan-magenta-purple illustrated skin, including the female-face graphic motifs. Do not invent a different gun, use two guns, curve its barrel, shorten the stock or replace the graphic skin with generic glowing gems.

NEW DESIGN REQUEST: Redesign her entire illustration apart from the face and body identity. Snowfield setting. Soft winter earmuffs visibly cover both ears, and her long dark brown hair is tied into ONE ponytail behind her head, with a few natural bangs and delicate loose strands. Hair flows continuously and naturally: no stacked plate-like layers, thick ribbon-shaped hair clumps or plastic highlights. Outfit is a refined off-shoulder, sleeveless/tank-style CROP TOP with a VERY SMALL folded collar detail; shoulders visibly bare, short hem showing a natural band of midriff. Do not bring back the old long-sleeved white coat, corset harness or large fur collar. Design coordinated fitted winter shorts and attractive practical tall boots, a restrained white/charcoal scheme and subtle cyan details harmonious with the weapon. Tailored fabric, soft knit earmuffs, leather and metal each have distinct refined materials. Keep the adult silhouette natural and elegant.

COMPOSITION: New confident standing pose on a snowy ledge, feet naturally grounded with weight on one leg and knees anatomically aligned; do not repeat the reference's crossed-leg walking pose or raised handgun pose. New gentle three-quarter head angle and gaze while preserving her exact facial identity. Hold the referenced rifle naturally in both hands at a diagonal low-ready angle across the front, fully readable from buttstock through muzzle, away from her face and the dog. One gloved hand fully closes around the proper pistol/stock grip, the other supports the fore-end from below, wrists aligned, five natural fingers per hand, no gripping the scope or barrel. The long barrel, receiver and stock obey one rigid consistent perspective and straight mechanical axes. Compose with enough margins to show the whole rifle and both boots.

Place ONE healthy gray-and-white Siberian husky beside her, clearly visible in the lower part of the scene, alert ears and beautiful natural fur, believable adult-dog size and four-legged anatomy. It is her calm companion and must not obscure her leg silhouette or the rifle. New snowfield panorama with frosted conifers, distant blue-white mountains and a restrained fantasy outpost far behind, distinct from the old densely stacked snowy castle composition. Soft winter sunlight and faint falling snow; luminous face with clear eyes, crisp character and rifle details, painterly atmospheric depth behind. Premium polished 2D fantasy illustration, not a real photo, not chibi, not a plastic 3D render. No extra people, no additional animals, no text, letters, rank badges, logos, watermarks, borders or UI.

Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit.
Edit IMAGE 1, the approved snow sniper illustration, making ONLY the following requested corrections. Deliver one polished native 1024x1536 RGB PNG, exact 2:3 portrait.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the approved outfit, earmuffs, rear ponytail, snow landscape, husky, pose, full-body framing and painting-quality reference.
Image 2 is the original approved Namu Bongsoon adult avatar, the PRIMARY FACIAL IDENTITY reference.
Image 3 is the approved Lotte Namu Bongsoon adult avatar, corroborating the SAME face. Use Images 2 and 3 ONLY for the face, never their clothes, hair arrangement, pose or backgrounds.
Image 4 is the exact sniper rifle design and straight mechanical geometry reference.

1. FACE: Restore the recognizable Namu Bongsoon face from Images 2 and 3. Her softly rounded full cheeks, gently rounded jaw, specific warm brown eyes and eyelid shapes, eye spacing, subtle nose and small softly full lips must remain identifiable. The current Image 1 face looks too generic and narrow: correct that without inventing another person or enlarging her head or eyes. Angle her face only slightly more toward the viewer so both eyes and the facial structure read clearly, keep a calm expression and illuminate her face softly. Keep her adult age (twenties or older), natural bangs, earmuffs and long ponytail BEHIND the head. Do not substitute a childlike doll face, an exaggerated V-jaw or a different person.

2. BODY: Give this adult woman a visibly fuller, more voluptuous bust, approximately 20–25 percent more volume, naturally supported by the existing opaque white knit crop top. Keep the exact top design, neckline and coverage; adjust the knit contours, drape and shadows to fit. No transparency or exposed nipples, no added cleavage cutout. Preserve the approved slim waist, hips, leg length and thickness, overall adult body proportions, pose, shorts, boots, gloves, harness, tiny collar and accessories.

3. STRAIGHT RIFLE — CRITICAL: Replace the subtly bent/kinked weapon geometry in Image 1 with the rigid straight geometry of Image 4, preserving the same white/black/cyan/magenta/purple weapon skin and illustrated face motifs. Treat the entire rifle as ONE rigid mechanical object with one coherent perspective, rotated together to the current diagonal down-right orientation. The receiver's longitudinal axis and barrel axis must be straight and continuous; the scope's cylindrical axis must be straight and parallel to the barrel. The barrel must not kink where it leaves the fore-end, bend at the supporting hand, sag, curve or snake toward the muzzle. Preserve reference proportions, thumbhole stock, receiver, long barrel, scope, scope mounts and folded bipod. Straight continuous receiver rails, barrel edges and scope centerline. Do not independently distort or shrink any segment to fit the pose. Adjust the two hands minimally around the corrected rigid rifle instead: firing hand properly wrapped around the grip, support hand underneath the fore-end, natural wrists and five fingers. Whole rifle remains visible inside the canvas. No changed weapon model, no additional gun, no bent or disconnected stock/handle/scope/barrel.

PRESERVE EVERY OTHER ELEMENT: the already approved off-shoulder sleeveless crop-top winter outfit, white/charcoal palette, earmuffs, naturally flowing rear ponytail, snowfield and distant outpost, gray-white husky companion, realistic dog anatomy, composition, full legs and boots, lighting and premium semi-realistic 2D fantasy illustration finish. No new costume, no altered background or dog, no pose replacement, no extra people, no text, logos, watermarks, borders or UI. Natural continuous hair strands, never segmented plate-like or ribbon-like layers.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
IMAGE 1 is the edit target. IMAGE 2 is the exact correct sniper rifle reference.

Make ONE surgical correction: replace the ENTIRE rifle in Image 1 with a geometrically faithful, RIGID and STRAIGHT rendition of Image 2. The prior image is defective: the front barrel drops/bends downward relative to the receiver. Do NOT trace or preserve that defective rifle contour.

Remove the existing weapon shape and re-create the rifle as though the complete reference weapon was uniformly scaled and rotated as ONE rigid object, with zero nonlinear warping. Keep its exact reference thumbhole stock, white/black chassis, cyan-magenta-purple illustrated skin and female-face motifs, scope, scope mounts, full long barrel and folded bipod. Use a clear side-readable view, approximately 30 degrees clockwise downward toward image-right. Every part follows ONE coherent perspective. The receiver's bore axis must continue straight through the barrel to the muzzle. The long barrel is a straight rigid cylinder: both silhouette edges are straight, no sag, bow, curvature, bend or kink at the handguard or hand. Scope centerline and receiver rail follow the barrel's direction without divergent angles. The barrel must NOT tilt farther downward than the receiver. In this image the muzzle needs to come UP to align with the receiver; do not leave it at the existing lower crooked endpoint. Prioritize this mechanical continuity above preserving the old gun's exact pixel position.

Fit the hands to the corrected rigid weapon, not the weapon to the hands. Adjust only the smallest necessary hand/wrist contact regions: proper closed grip and supporting hand under fore-end. Do not use bent rifle geometry to retain hand placement. Keep the whole gun and muzzle inside the picture, with clean visible silhouette. No extra gun, no improvised rail extensions, no disconnected scope.

Keep EVERYTHING ELSE in Image 1 unchanged: the corrected adult Namu Bongsoon face, fuller bust and same opaque white cropped off-shoulder top, tiny collar, shoulders, slim waist and long legs, shorts, boots, hair tied behind into a ponytail, earmuffs, husky dog, snowy setting, painting finish, camera and body pose. The gun's alignment is the only requested change. Preserve the premium semi-realistic game illustration quality. No text, guides, ruler lines, overlays, labels, UI, watermarks or frame. One 1024x1536 native RGB PNG.

reproducibility.note: Original absolute tool inputs are retained verbatim. The final candidate and its two direct inputs are copied into this preview without recompression.
